title: Route Constellation Mini-Logbook: Per-model & Per-route Performance UX and Chart Specs
creator: Maya Thompson
description: This ticket captures the design work for a compact, scannable "mini-logbook" view focused on per-model and per-route performance signals. The goal is a lightweight card + expanded inspector pattern that surfaces latency distributions, throughput trends, token composition, and rollout impact in a single interaction path. It must work in narrow side panels and in a mid-size canvas, and should be resilient to missing telemetry or high-cardinality routes. Deliverables: annotated wireframes, chart encoding rules, a tiny interactive prototype for stakeholder review, and an acceptance checklist for Engineering handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Compact card displays 95th, p50, and p99 latency and throughput sparkline for a 24h window
Expanded inspector shows latency quantiles heatband, token type/length distribution, and request sample microtrace link
Charts use unified color palette and consistent time-binning defaults (1m for <24h, 5m for 24-168h)
Design tokens and spacing match Console system. CSS tokens provided in handoff
Prototype demonstrates degraded-state behavior (no KV cache hits, partial metrics) and fallback UI copy
Engineering sign-off on chart specs and a PRD alignment meeting completed
tasks: Create compact card wireframes for route list (small / medium / large states)
Design expanded inspector layout with 3 chart regions: latency quantiles, throughput & concurrency, token composition
Define chart encodings: quantile band calc, binning, error bars, sample size annotations
Prepare figma file with component variants and responsive rules
Build clickable prototype (Figma) for demo + record 2-minute walkthrough
Sync with ENG owners on data availability and API endpoints
Write handoff document with chart spec table and example payloads
